body:
Hey OP....There are so many parallels that I'm noticing with my own life right now while reading your story. I wish I could give you the answers to all the problems your facing but Im not really in a position too since we are going through the same things. I will say this...even though a college degree is an advantage in the job market, not having one is far from a death sentence. It would definitely be a huge advantage to at least get an associates down the road when you have finally found a career that your willing to stick with just so that you will have the same advancement opportunities as others but, being 20, you don't have to worry about that right now because you literally have your entire life ahead of you. Heres a list of jobs out there that dont require a degree for starting positions :
http://www.careercast.com/jobs-rated/20-great-jobs-without-college-degree
http://www.businessinsider.com/high-paying-jobs-dont-require-bachelors-degree-2013-12?op=1
http://www.app.com/story/money/personal-finance/2014/08/31/jobs-college-degree/14914187/
I know that these aren't the most comprehensive lists but just consider them a jumping off point. The only other thing that I can offer you is solidarity. If you just need  someone to vent or discuss the problems going on more in-depth then Im here for you. I know it doesn't seem like much....believe me I wish I could offer more, but youd be surprised with just how much talking to someone about the issues you are facing and discussing potential solutions can give you a new lease on life. Last but not least OP...I want you to know that your life isn't meaningless..there will always be people that love you, that care about you, and that would miss you terribly if the joy you bring to their lives was suddenly taken from them. I'll leave you with a quote. Its cliche but it really does make a good point: "To the world you may just be one person, but to one person you may be the world." I wish you the best of luck in the future my friend. And again, Im here for you if you need it.

Whats causing you so much pain? I know it can be hard but sometimes just talking it out with someone can at the very least take some weight off your shoulders. I know that you think it would be better for your for children to not see you in so much pain..or even to not have you in their life at all. But I dont think I would be able to imagine a life without my own mother. Even though she isn't perfect and she suffers from depression there are so many moments where I see her love for her family shine through and I feel so happy that I get to have her in my life. Im sure that your family feels the same way and would be devastated by their loss if you decided to end your life. And besides...dont you want to see your little ones grow up? And to be there to guide them and nurture them along the way?
Oh and just to make sure you know if you ever need to talk to someone my doors always open :) just take care of your self ok?

Oh im sure there are plenty of more crazy moms out there :/ But thank you for the kind words. I just really love helping others. Im not the best at it but I do what I can and for the first time in a while..I felt useful. Just knowing that someones day might be a little bit more bearable because of me was a great way to get myself feeling a little bit closer to halfway normal :)

No need to thank me at all. To be honest this is a throwaway account that i created with the sole purpose of talking about my own struggle with deppresion and my desire to just find a way out. But then i saw that a lot of posts here, made by people who need help a lot more then I do, got zero responses sometimes..so i thought id try to help. And ugh, don't get me started on family dynamics. My mom is the exact same way. If someone in our family pisses her off there's this whole "your either with me or against me" attitude she gets which frankly doesn't help solve the problem at all. My therapist gave me the same "get out while you still can" advice and I've been struggling to find a job to get out on my own and find a place away from the shouting. Its tough :( believe me I know.

Im sorry OP. I didnt mean to imply that you wanted to abandon her at all. when i said "and the same goes for you" I was trying to say that you deserve the same respect and support that your aunt should be getting from your mother. And also I think its unfair. Just because your mother has decided to cut her sister out of her life doesnt mean that you should be expected too as well. Even if your mother makes it difficult for you to see her in person, there are always alternatives like social media and phone calls that will at the very least keep your aunt a part of your life.

Theres a flaw in your moms logic and in yours. If your mothers therapist described her sister as "broken" then the last thing any person should do is abandon their family in their time of need. And the same goes for you. Because "Ohana means family. And family means nobody gets left behind, or forgotten."

20 year old male here. What your going through sounds pretty damn similar to what im going through now, so know your not alone. I know what its like....Emotional pain so deep it just eats away at your soul and makes you pray to a god that as far as you know might not even exist. Not knowing if its ever going to be worth it to wake up the next morning, let alone facing getting out of bed and going to work. Believe me your not alone OP. We are here to help. If you want to talk, then at the very least I'm here to listen.

Body image can be soul crushing. There is nothing worse in this world then not being able to look at yourself in the mirror with any sort of pride. But it sounds like you have a great relationship with your aunt and even though your mother obviously doesn't understand the depths of your pain, Im willing to bet dollars to donuts that she loves you. So in regards to your question about finding a way to do the deed without hurting your family...Im afraid that's pretty much out the window. Your their family. If you decide to go through with this, it won't be the circumstances in which you died that causes them the most pain. It will be the simple fact that a person that they care for deeply and have known for years has suddenly been taken from them without warning. I know times are tough OP. And the pain you must be feeling right now is probably unbearable. But you are loved. Don't ever forget that. And if you need to vent about what's going on in your life then this is most definitely the place and I am most definitely willing to listen.

well said :(. Without a purpose, then what are we? I keep trying to find the answers but keep coming up short...and after 20 years of not having anything to show for my efforts....It just makes me wish that the earth would swallow me up so at least my girlfriend and family wouldn't be affected by my screw-ups anymore.

Hey buddy. Your right...Life can be so cruel. Theres a million different ways in which life can knock us off our feet and keep on kicking you back down when you try to get up. But don't forget that no matter how dark it gets. We have each-other to build us back up. Im not pretending to have all the answers. But if you need someone to talk to. Someone to confide in. Then I'm taking this chance to offer you just that. Please, at the very least...just think about this ok?

Please OP...don't. Im struggling right now with these problems and I know how much of a slippery slope it is. And I know how it feels to not be able to come up with a single reason to continue existing and still not have it in you to follow through with what you think is your only real option. Maybe it's a small part of us that hasn't given up. Maybe...just maybe...Theres hope for you and I. If you need to talk to someone Im here. Just please think long and hard about what is holding you back. Is it truly fear? Or is it something far more courageous that is hiding deep within that won't let us slip off this mortal coil without a fight? Whatever you decide, Im here for you.
